newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Endemol reports H1 net up 19 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Endemol reports H1 net up 19 percent.

text.p: Dutch television producer Endemol on Tuesday reported first-half 1996/97 net profits jumped 19 percent and reiterated its forecast of a 15-20 percent rise in full-year earnings.
Net profits in the first 1996/97 half ended January 31 rose to 33.7 million guilders ($17.5 million) from a year-earlier 28.3 million.
Turnover mushroomed by 38 percent to 441 million guilders, boosted by further growth in television activities at home and abroad and the group's acquisition of Holiday on Ice.
"The management board maintains the expectation expressed earlier that the net result for the entire 1996/97 book year will rise by 15 to 20 percent," Endemol said in a statement.
The group's fiscal year runs to July 31.
Operating profits rose six million guilders to 43 million.
The net profit figure came in just under analysts' forecasts, who had been predicting first-half net of 36-40 million guilders.
Endemol shares closed at 61.0 guilders on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange on Monday. ($ = 1.929 Dutch Guilders)
